competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Binance's replacement program creates measurable XRP spot or OTC demand.
support: Binance says it is buying remaining relevant token assets through market and OTC channels.
XRP was among the assets transferred in the incident.
disconfirming_or_alternative: The announcement does not name XRP or disclose token-by-token quantities.
Binance may satisfy obligations from existing inventory, internal transfers or OTC counterparties.
competing_hypotheses.test: Reconcile the post-incident PoR address export, token-specific reserve balances, public XRP wallet inflows and any disclosed execution data.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The 233.46M XRP remains at the incident receiver as of the current cutoff.
support: TRM reported the XRP remained at the receiver as of 2026-10-30 00:30 UTC.
disconfirming_or_alternative: No fresh XRPL account_info or transaction-history read was completed by 2026-10-31 04:24 UTC.
competing_hypotheses.test: Read the receiver's validated XRPL account state and complete transaction history from an authorized public node; preserve ledger index and query timestamp.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The XRP Ledger protocol itself was exploited in the Binance incident.
support: The first observed large transfers in the multi-chain incident occurred on XRPL.
disconfirming_or_alternative: TRM describes ordinary signed XRPL transfers and a broader Binance hot-wallet signing-infrastructure compromise; no XRPL consensus or protocol exploit is evidenced.
competing_hypotheses.test: Compare transaction validity and signing-path findings in Binance's technical postmortem; keep protocol-level and exchange-infrastructure causes separate.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Circle or Ripple could freeze the stolen native XRP using their stablecoin issuer controls.
support: Circle froze USDC and Ripple froze RLUSD issued-token balances.
disconfirming_or_alternative: XRPL documentation explicitly states issuer freeze controls do not apply to native XRP.
competing_hypotheses.test: Maintain asset-type checks in the graph: XRP native balance, RLUSD/USDC/USDT issued balances and custodial exchange claims are separate.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The Binance incident establishes a directional XRP price effect.
support: Incident timing coincides with elevated long liquidations and a subsequent market shock.
disconfirming_or_alternative: 24h windows straddle the incident, OI providers differ by 2.13x, ETF flow is partial, and broader crypto/macro events confound attribution.
competing_hypotheses.test: Run a timestamped event study against BTC/ETH controls, spot depth, venue-specific OI/funding, ETF final flows and verified incident-wallet movements.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: TraderTraitor is conclusively established as the perpetrator.
support: TRM attributes the attack with high confidence using on-chain and off-chain intelligence.
disconfirming_or_alternative: Binance's public update says the investigation is ongoing and does not name the threat actor.
competing_hypotheses.test: Wait for corroborating law-enforcement or independently attributable evidence; preserve TRM's confidence as a sourced claim, not an official finding.
